protocol.study: Fixed terminal-reserve guard on unchanged final CUDA policies
protocol.design: Four cases: nominal/high drag1.1 at55/110 decisions; eight policies on4400/8800 physical cells:64 deterministic rollouts. One fixed guard; no tuning, retraining, checkpoint selection, parameter fitting or telemetry.
protocol.transfer: All three original final16384-step CUDA policies remain unchanged. Every policy uses the original six observations and physical0.1MJ reserve normalization. Guard protects an additional0.25MJ until the last1/55 lap action span (one block at55, two at110); then releases the protected budget and forces full request. The assumed conservative budget is intended to cover this short full-request span; it is not a calculated minimum or a feasibility guarantee.
protocol.primary_endpoint: Fine-grid PPO advantage against strongest matched guarded fixed baseline, reported only when all eight fine-grid policies pass feasibility/accounting; mean, sample SD and range over all three seeds.
protocol.secondary_endpoint: Guard interventions and nominal110-minus55 time changes. Guarded zero requests terminal assistance and is no longer a zero-electrical-deployment diagnostic.
protocol.numerical_gate: Original feasibility/accounting gates unchanged. Relative coarse/fine lap error<=0.005 and gain discrepancy<=0.05s against matching guarded zero. Guarded-zero block durations define the common reward reference, assigned after its physical replay without another rollout. Guard-disabled exact replay is tested separately; guard-enabled nominal identity to unguarded checkpoints is not expected.
protocol.failure_policy: A new output directory is required. Preserve contract, partial traces, errors and hashes. Any missing/failed rollout, provenance mismatch, source mutation or numerical failure makes the study unaccepted; do not exclude failed seeds or average incomplete groups.
protocol.interpretation: Replay-verified heuristic on this declared assumed-model matrix only. No universal or recursive feasibility, optimality, robustness beyond tested cases, convergence, significance or real-car claim. Original sensitivity failure remains unchanged. Further guard changes require a new protocol and output directory.

config.interpretation: Bounded model-based controller study. Baseline ranking and time-gain checks support a pilot, not a continuous-action optimum or general grid-independent RL ranking. Replay the trained policy at the fine grid.

reference.scope: Assumed point-mass research reference, not a fitted F1 car or regulatory specification
limitations: All vehicle and grip values are declared assumptions, not telemetry-estimated component powers.
450 kW base plus at most 120 kW electrical gives 570 kW total; effective total-power fits are not added.
Independent lateral and longitudinal constraints; no combined-slip tyre model, downforce map, grade, regeneration or DRS.
Source origin is retained; it is not certified to coincide with the official timing line.
Periodic speed for a single finite-energy lap does not imply battery periodicity or a sustainable race strategy.
